content.title: Pelicans+
content.text: A subscription for Pelicans+ gives fans living in Louisiana and surrounding areas access to live local games, and more for the entire season and offseason. Fans living in parts of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama can purchase a subscription to watch all local games for the New Orleans Pelicans that were previously available only on your regional cable channel. Fans who reside in areas considered to be "in-market" for the New Orleans Pelicans, which includes parts of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama can purchase a Pelicans+ subscription. Search for your zip code here to see if you are in the eligible market. A locally broadcast game is one that would usually be shown on your local regional sports channel, rather than a national channel such as ESPN, ABC, NBC, Peacock, or Amazon Prime Video. All games broadcast on your local regional sports channel will be available for viewing with Pelicans+. National blackouts will apply when a game is broadcast exclusively on a national TV channel.Pelicans+ offers a season-long subscription that will renew prior to each season. You will be notified around 30 days prior to being charged. Pelicans+ also offers a monthly subscription that will renew each month unless cancelled. To see pricing and purchase Pelicans+, please visit the packages page here.What content streams and features are available via Pelicans+? Pelicans+ includes access to the Pelicans feed for live game access. Fans will also have access to insider team content, a Pelicans+ hub, and more!What devices are compatible with Pelicans+? You can access your Pelicans+ subscription through the NBA App across our supported devices, including mobile and tablets, Connected Devices and TVs, Gaming Consoles, and on NBA.com.Live games and on-demand replays are also available at watch.pelicans.com.What happens if I am traveling? Can I still watch Pelicans games on Pelicans+?Subscribers can still access Pelicans+ when they are away from the New Orleans Pelicans market, traveling within the US, for 30 days.How can I access my Pelicans+ subscription? Access your subscription to Pelicans+ through the NBA App and NBA.com. Open the NBA App or navigate to NBA.com Login with your NBA ID, the information used during the purchase of your Pelicans+ subscription Navigate to the Games tab Select a Pelicans game Select the watch button to watch the game! Can I purchase both Pelicans+ and NBA League Pass subscription?Absolutely! Pelicans+ is the only way to stream locally televised Pelicans games without a cable or satellite subscription if you live in-market. However, if you would like to access games for other teams across the league, you can purchase an NBA League Pass subscription in addition to your Pelicans+ subscription. Please note that national and local blackouts will still apply to other teams. To purchase an NBA League Pass subscription, see here.Can I watch the Pelicans Summer League games?Yes! With a Pelicans+ subscription, you can watch live Pelicans Summer League games. If I am having issues, where do I go?If you are having issues signing up for Pelicans+ or watching games, please reach out to our support team here.If you are having issues watching games on pelicans.kiswe.com, please reach out to support@pelicans.com.
